readerEvidence.summary: Complete personal single-pass visual reading of all41 original question/key pages. Six whole A1–A4/B1–B2 problems, all30 native leaf parts, all6 complete worked keys and alternate arguments, all cover/supervisor instructions and16 constants retained. Three native question diagrams, four required blank answer-sheet occurrences and six actual graphical key crops personally inspected as exact final PNG bytes. Printed key defects remain explicit. No separate model checker.

problems.scope: Complete 13-page original: supervisor instructions, student cover and all16 useful-information entries, A1–A4 and B1–B2 complete question prose with all30 native leaf parts, Part A STOP page, Part B and answer-sheet boundaries, all3 problem diagrams and all4 original answer-sheet occurrences.

solutions.scope: Complete 28-page matching original key: supervisor instructions and cover/constants; repeated A1–A4/B1–B2 questions; every worked solution, alternate derivation and explanatory commentary; all6 graphical answers; Part A STOP page, Part B and answer-sheet boundaries; all4 repeated answer sheets. Printed AAPT copyright and United States Physics Team 2014 identity on original matching key establish authorship.

Full conducting shell, a/b radii, cavity, x/y axes and finite shell thickness.

Second original blank graph answer-sheet occurrence separately inspected and preserved, although exact image bytes equal the first.

Full centered-charge E(x) graph with all handwritten field and radius labels.
Full centered-charge V(x) graph with all handwritten shifted-potential/radius labels.

Full shell and every interior/exterior field-line arrow, including all outer arrowheads.
Complete ball/block diagram, curved hole, m/M labels, velocity arrow and frictionless-surface line/label.

sourceGaps: All six worked solutions are present and retained. No missing solution is inferred or filled.
The original gives whole-problem allocations25/50 but no per-subpart point breakdown or separate marking rubric; none is invented.
Two off-centre handwritten graph source bitmaps contain partial bottom point-charge labels. Entire native bitmap borders are retained; no redrawing or invented restoration.

Administrative cover/instruction and repeated question/answer-sheet pages are read completely and original bytes remain retained. Identical source repetitions are normalized as metadata/question text while both distinct required Question4 blank graph-sheet occurrences remain available.

sourceContradictions.description: Expanded invariant-distance polynomial prints +1/2 g v0 sin(theta0) t^3 despite preceding squared expression. Printed factor1/2 retained.
Key uses theta rather than question theta0 and then reuses theta for the trajectory subtended angle. Both printed uses retained.
Question separation is d; key switches to h in t1≈t2≈h/c and final frequency multiplier1+gh/c². It calls this redshift despite the printed positive multiplier. Original symbols and wording retained.
Source says For r < b before giving point-charge exterior-field dependence. Original inequality retained.
Piecewise electric-field formula prints denominator2 epsilon, while preceding expression uses2 epsilon0. Printed missing subscript retained.
Original prints infinitely long wire wire; repeated word retained in question/key.
Historical commentary prints leaving inevitably to all of special relativity; wording retained.
Printed friction argument assumes v1 same as part(a) and relates v4=v2/(1+2/5). Native argument/formulas retained without replacement by an editorial physical derivation.
Bottom point-charge handwritten words are clipped within the original graph bitmap. Crop extends beyond the entire bitmap gray border and does not introduce clipping.
